summary: Q2 (the r2 blocking defect) is repaired. The complete planned flow succeeds from the repository root of a clean checkout with no pre-created output directory: accepted review for HEAD, then make_freeze, freeze commit, empty git status, ready, execute. This holds under Python 3.9 and 3.14, with and without -B, with synthetic data sources, and with the REAL historical K4 report (synthetic K1/slot-1/T-EXT). A crash after the reservation is recorded and spends the run; a second execute or ready is refused. Mathematics, universe, inheritance, provenance (16/16), adoption and endpoint semantics still hold, and no target value exists anywhere. The candidate is nevertheless REJECTED on one new blocking defect, Q3, in the r3 freeze builder. make_freeze binds the on-disk namespace (modified tracked, untracked and gitignored files alike) while recording qualified_candidate_commit = HEAD. Nothing in make_freeze, ready or execute verifies that the freeze commit differs from the qualified candidate only by the review files and FREEZE.json/FREEZE_HASH. Demonstrated on synthetic copies: (1) an unqualified code edit is frozen, committed, and passes ready in a fresh clone, under a FREEZE.json that names the unmodified candidate. (2) A gitignored file (.DS_Store, stray .pyc) is bound but never committed, so ready in a clean checkout of the freeze commit refuses, and a later rewrite of that file makes execute refuse, which ends the lineage under stop_conditions.

blocking_defects.title: The qualified freeze builder does not bind what it claims; the freeze composition is enforced only in prose
blocking_defects.detail: make_freeze.py's docstring says the freeze 'binds exactly the candidate that was qualified, plus the review itself'. GATE.freeze_procedure says 'The freeze commit adds only the review files and FREEZE.json/FREEZE_HASH on top of the qualified candidate'. Neither statement is enforced. make_freeze hashes whatever is on disk under the namespace (rglob), and excludes only __pycache__, .pytest_cache and execution_r1. It records qualified_candidate_commit = HEAD without checking git status. verify_freeze and launch_gates never check that HEAD differs from qualified_candidate_commit only by the allowed files.

demonstrations.tracked_code_edit: k4r1_certificate.py is edited after qualification. make_freeze returns rc 0, and FREEZE.qualified_candidate_commit is the unmodified candidate. The freeze commit contains 'M code/k4r1_certificate.py'. ready passes both in the same worktree and in a fresh clone.
demonstrations.untracked_extra: A stray evidence/notes_tmp.txt is bound and committed with the freeze, and ready passes.
demonstrations.ignored_dsstore: config/.DS_Store is bound but never committed. ready in a fresh clone is REFUSED. After a rewrite of the file, execute is REFUSED while git status stays empty, and a refusal of execute ends the lineage.
demonstrations.ignored_pyc_outside_pycache: code/k4r1_certificate.pyc is bound and never committed, and ready in a fresh clone is REFUSED.

blocking_defects.why_blocking: The freeze is the only link between the qualified candidate and the executed code under the exactly-once rule. r3 introduces make_freeze as 'the qualified freeze builder', but its stated guarantee is not wired in. Several plausible operator actions would then either execute unqualified content or spuriously end the lineage: copying reviewer artifacts into the namespace, a Finder-created .DS_Store, or editing a status line at freeze time. The repair is small and mechanical.
repair: make_freeze: refuse unless `git status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all -- <namespace>` lists only untracked files under the named review directory, allowing only the excluded caches. Bind `git ls-files <namespace>` at HEAD, plus those review files, plus the PROVENANCE sources, instead of rglob.

launch_gates: refuse unless `git diff --name-only <qualified_candidate_commit> HEAD` is exactly {the review files, config/FREEZE.json, config/FREEZE_HASH}, and qualified_candidate_commit is an ancestor of HEAD.

Tests: make_freeze refuses a modified tracked file, an extra untracked file and an ignored non-cache file; ready refuses any extra change in the freeze commit; a fresh-clone positive control passes ready.
Runbook: name which reviewer files may be placed in review/qualification_rN/ (the JSON and MD, plus optionally small scripts). Never nested repositories, virtualenvs or simulation trees.

non_blocking_notes.text: The crash record should include executed_at_head and freeze_sha256. X3 is untested. Document that a SIGKILL leaves an empty reservation, which still counts as the one execution.
Move the M3 ≥ 0 and M5 ≥ 0 majorant sign check into extract_inputs, so that ready and preflight catch a malformed source before the reservation.
Add tests that kill X15, MF4, MF5 and MF10.
stop_conditions does not mention ready. State whether a ready refusal stops the lineage.
